elements.element: Customer is not subject to any exclusivity obligation.
elements.evidence: Section 2.2 expressly states that Customer has no exclusivity obligation, and Section 12.3 confirms that Customer may engage any supplier and has made no exclusivity commitment.

elements.element: Customer is not subject to any sole-supplier obligation.
elements.evidence: Section 2.2 expressly states that Customer has no sole-supplier obligation and designates Vendor as non-exclusive.

elements.element: Any exclusivity obligation binding Customer is limited to a defined product category.
elements.evidence: The condition is demonstrably absent: the operative language imposes no exclusivity obligation at all, so no broader exclusivity can bind Customer.

elements.element: Any exclusivity obligation binding Customer lasts no more than 12 months.
elements.evidence: The condition is demonstrably absent: the operative language imposes no exclusivity obligation, including one extending beyond 12 months.

elements.element: Any exclusivity obligation binding Customer ends automatically upon Vendor's failure to meet applicable service levels.
elements.evidence: The condition is demonstrably absent because Customer has no exclusivity obligation requiring termination upon a service-level failure.

elements.element: Any exclusivity obligation binding Customer ends automatically upon Vendor's failure to meet applicable delivery dates.
elements.evidence: The condition is demonstrably absent because Customer has no exclusivity obligation requiring termination upon a delivery-date failure.

result.reason: The rendered clause directly removes the sole-and-exclusive-provider obligation and affirmatively states that Vendor is non-exclusive and Customer has no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation. Because no exclusivity remains, each conditional fallback limitation is satisfied by the demonstrable absence of an exclusivity obligation. The amendment is confined to the targeted exclusivity provision, aligns with Sections 2.1 and 12.3, and introduces no contradiction or unrelated commercial requirement.
